result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: mispositioned delivery-time badge and vertical misalignment on the middle 'Fastest near you' card, and inconsistent favorite-icon background in 'Popular right now'.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you' row, the '20-30 min' badge on 'Smash Bros Burgers' straddles the bottom edge of the image and sits half outside on the white background, while badges on neighboring cards are fully inside the image. The middle card image also appears vertically offset lower than the adjacent cards.
issues.suggestion: Align all time badges consistently inside the bottom-left of the card image with the same inset/padding and align card image tops to the same baseline.

issues.description: Favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now': 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows a bare white outline heart directly on the photo with no background, while the pizza card below shows the heart inside a dark translucent circular scrim, making the first icon low-contrast and hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same circular scrim background container to all favorite heart buttons for consistent contrast and tap target.
